_instructions: Copy this file to your SERVICEFLOW_DATA_DIR as 'config.json' and fill in your values. Default data dir: ~/.claude/channels/line
_WHITELIST_MODE: true = only developer + admin get responses (soft launch). false = open to all users (production).
_EXISTING_CLIENT_DETECTION: true = apply Tier 1 routing for returning-client signals (agent goes silent, human handles). false = treat everyone as a new client.
_firm_name: Used in agent persona and client-facing messages. Replaces {{YOUR_FIRM_NAME}} in CLAUDE.md.
_team_name: The human operator team name used in escalation messages. Replaces {{YOUR_TEAM_NAME}} in CLAUDE.md.

roles._developer: LINE userId of the technical operator. Has full access including architecture/system commands.
roles._admin: LINE userId of the business operator. Can run: lookup / takeover / resume / close / emergency_close.
